title: Doyayo language
text: The Doyayo language, also known as Dooyaayɔ or Dowayo (ISO 639-3: dow), is a Niger-Congo language spoken by the Dowayo (or Doowaayɔ) people, the largest indigenous ethnic group in Cameroon's Département de Faro.
